neetcode250.method: Read the main JavaScript asset explicitly linked by the official NeetCode 250 practice page. Parse flat public metadata records containing neetcode250:!0 without executing the JavaScript. Extract only IDs, titles, slugs, difficulty, topic and membership flags; no problem statements or editorials copied. Numeric IDs come from the code filename prefix. Preserve source record order.
neetcode250.caveat: Membership is the current published snapshot at retrieval time; NeetCode can revise lists. This collection is distinct from all problems in the code repository.

originalGuides.scope: Exactly NC250 members not flagged NC150 in the official page asset.
originalGuides.authorship: Original short study briefs, algorithm/invariant explanations, edge-case prompts, and target complexity notes. No problem statements, editorial prose, or reference code copied into this file.
originalGuides.grounding: Public metadata, available MIT-licensed NeetCode repository implementations, and direct primary LeetCode contract checks for selected missing implementations. Target strategies may deliberately differ from the imported reference code; complexities explicitly identify relevant variants.
originalGuides.validation: JSON/schema checked; every required numeric ID appears once; no NC150-only entry; all 100 entries contain three edge-case prompts. This task did not execute or validate the imported reference code.

referenceCode.scope: Only credited reference code imported; original independent guides. No LeetCode problem statements or editorials copied.
